sources.document_title: Shenzhen Hanxia Electronic Co., Ltd slide switch SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL (承认书), served by JLCPCB for C5149819
sources.locator: page index 0: Hanxia cover, Part No. blank; page index 1: 1.1 RATING, 1.2 temperature, 2.1-2.3 electrical, 3.1-3.2 operation force and travel; page index 2: 4.1 life test, 4.2-4.4 environment, 4.5 soldering conditions; page index 3: drawing (contact schematic A/B/C, side and top views, recommended land, spec table)
sources.evidence_extract: Rating DC 12V 0.1A; operating temperature -25..+70 C; contact resistance 50 mOhm max at 1 kHz, 100 mA or less; insulation 100 MOhm min at 500 VDC; withstand AC 250 V 1 min; operation force 190 +/-30 gf; travel 1.5 +/-0.2 mm; life 10,000 cycles (no load, contact resistance 50 mOhm max after); reflow <=250 C, iron 350 C 2 s or 270 C 4 s. Drawing: terminals 1-4, A = 1-3, B = 2-3, C = 3-4 (3 common); body 9.7 x 2.7 x 1.4, pegs dia 0.73, 0.5 long, at 5, centred on the 2.7 depth (1.35/1.35), terminals 0.4 wide protruding 1 beyond the body edge at 1.5/3/1.5, actuator 1.3 wide x 1.1 thick projecting 1.5 on the opposite long edge; recommended land: 4 pads 0.7 wide at 1.5/3/1.5 from 1.05 to 2.65 off the peg line, 4 retention pads 1 x 0.9 (gap 1.4 about the peg line, inner span 9.3), 2 x dia 0.9 holes at 5.
sources.authority_note: A Hanxia-branded document served by the distributor (JLC dataManualFileAccessIdUrl; LCSC dataManualUrl above) for C5149819. Its Part No. field is blank and the PDF metadata title names another model (LY-SK-23), so the binding to HX MSK13C02 rests on the distributor only. No Hanxia-hosted copy was found (web search 2026-11-12). Mirror authority: values stay UNVERIFIED.
